teaser.en: Its name and its main use are one and the same: *mdege* is medicine against *dege*. Pakia gives *dege* as the evil eye; the Mgombato dictionary gives it as *nyuni*, a convulsive illness of young children blamed on certain birds.
teaser.sw: Jina lake na matumizi yake makuu ni kitu kimoja: *mdege* ni dawa dhidi ya *dege*. Pakia anaeleza *dege* kuwa jicho baya; kamusi ya Mgombato inaeleza kuwa ni *nyuni*, degedege ya watoto wadogo inayoaminika kuletwa na ndege fulani.
teaser.dg: Dzinare na kaziye kulu ni chitu chimwenga: *mdege* ni dawa ya *dege*. Kpwa Pakia, *dege* ni dzitso ribaya (*evil eye*); kpwa kamusi ya Mgombato ni *nyuni*, ukongo wa ana adide wa kugbwa gafula na kukakama, ambao atu anaamini unarehwa ni nyuni fulani.

summary.en: *Mdege* is a small resinous tree of coastal bushland and thicket with peeling bark. The Digo use it as medicine against *dege*, which Pakia records as the evil eye and the Mgombato dictionary as *nyuni*, a convulsive illness of young children blamed on certain birds.
summary.sw: *Mdege* ni mti mdogo wenye utomvu wa ubani, wa vichaka na vichaka vizito vya pwani, wenye gome linalobambuka. Wadigo huutumia kama dawa dhidi ya *dege*: kwa mujibu wa Pakia ni jicho baya, na kwa mujibu wa kamusi ya Mgombato ni *nyuni*, degedege ya watoto wadogo inayoaminika kuletwa na ndege fulani.
summary.dg: *Mdege* ni muhi mdide wenye ulimbo, wa weruni na vitsaka vya pwani, wenye gopha rinarotuluka vipande-vipande. Adigo anauhumira dza dawa ya *dege*: kpwa Pakia ni dzitso ribaya (*evil eye*), na kpwa kamusi ya Mgombato ni *nyuni*, ukongo wa ana adide wa kugbwa gafula na kukakama, ambao atu anaamini unarehwa ni nyuni fulani.

about.en: *Mdege* is a small tree of the myrrh family, rich in fragrant resin. Its bark peels away in papery flakes, showing fresh, often greenish bark underneath. Like its relatives, it is likely to lose its leaves in the dry season.
about.sw: *Mdege* ni mti mdogo wa familia ya manemane, wenye utomvu mwingi wenye harufu nzuri. Gome lake hubambuka kwa vibanzi vyembamba kama karatasi, na kuonyesha gome jipya chini yake, mara nyingi la rangi ya kijani. Kama jamaa zake, huenda hupukutisha majani wakati wa kiangazi.
about.dg: *Mdege* ni muhi mdide wa jamii ya *myrrh*, na una ulimbo wenye arufu nono kpwa unji. Gophare rinatuluka kpwa vipande vyembamba dza karatasi, na photsi kunaonekana gopha riphya, mara nyinji ra chijani. Dza nduguze, inaelekea kukala makodzage ganagbwa wakati wa kazikazi.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and thicket.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka na vichaka vizito vya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na vitsakani vya pwani.

uses.en: Pakia records that *mdege* is used as medicine against *dege*, which he glosses as the evil eye. In the Mgombato dictionary *dege* is another name for *nyuni*, a convulsive illness of young children traditionally blamed on certain birds; Mgombato's word for the evil eye is *dzongo*.
uses.sw: Pakia anarekodi kwamba *mdege* hutumika kama dawa dhidi ya *dege*, ambalo analieleza kuwa jicho baya. Katika kamusi ya Mgombato, *dege* ni jina jingine la *nyuni*, degedege inayowapata watoto wadogo na inayoaminika tangu zamani kuletwa na ndege fulani; neno la Mgombato la jicho baya ni *dzongo*.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala *mdege* nkuhumirwa dza dawa ya *dege*, na anaeleza kukala *dege* ni dzitso ribaya (*evil eye*). Kpwenye kamusi ya Mgombato, *dege* ni dzina ranjina ra *nyuni*, ukongo wa ana adide wa kugbwa gafula na kukakama, ambao atu anaamini unarehwa ni nyuni fulani; neno ra Mgombato ra dzitso ribaya ni *dzongo*.

culture.en: The tree's name comes from its use: *mdege* is the medicine against *dege*. The word has two recorded meanings: Pakia gives the evil eye, while the Mgombato dictionary gives *nyuni*, a convulsive illness of young children blamed on certain birds (its word for the evil eye is *dzongo*). It is a clear example of how Digo plant names often record what a plant is for.
culture.sw: Jina la mti huu linatokana na matumizi yake: *mdege* ni dawa dhidi ya *dege*. Neno hili lina maana mbili zilizorekodiwa: Pakia anatoa jicho baya, na kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *nyuni*, degedege ya watoto wadogo inayoaminika kuletwa na ndege fulani (neno lake la jicho baya ni *dzongo*). Ni mfano mzuri wa jinsi majina ya mimea ya Kidigo mara nyingi yanavyohifadhi kazi ya mmea.
culture.dg: Dzina ra muhi rinalavywa kula kaziye: *mdege* ni dawa ya *dege*. Neno *dege* rina mana mbiri: Pakia anapha dzitso ribaya (*evil eye*), na kamusi ya Mgombato inapha *nyuni*, ukongo wa ana adide wa kugbwa gafula na kukakama, ambao atu anaamini unarehwa ni nyuni fulani (neno ra Mgombato ra dzitso ribaya ni *dzongo*). Ni mfwano mnono wa vira madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo mara nyinji ganavyoonyesa kazi ya mmea.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mdege*. No Swahili or English name has been recorded; its scientific name is *Commiphora zanzibarica*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mdege*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; jina lake la kisayansi ni *Commiphora zanzibarica*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mdege*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Commiphora zanzibarica*.

reason.en: Another plant named for its use in healing
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine uliopewa jina kutokana na matumizi yake katika uganga
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina uriohewa dzina kula kpwa kaziye ya dawa
